assets.prompt:
Brand mark for a software company, drawn as one member of an existing family of marks. Flat geometric vector: every shape constructed from circles, squares and 45-degree chamfers on a single grid, one uniform stroke weight throughout, sharp corners left sharp, generous negative space, optically centred. High contrast against a warm ash ground (#12100f) with exactly one accent colour — #e8622c — which is the single hue present in the whole image. Flat fills only: this is a vector graphic of the kind an SVG file holds. Every shape is one single solid block of colour, exactly the same value at its centre as at its rim, and every edge is a hard boundary where one flat colour stops and the next flat colour begins. The whole image lies on one plane and is built from pure areas of colour, in the register of a printed pictogram on a road sign. Confident and minimal, and legible at 16 pixels. Every curve in it is an arc of a true circle and every straight is a straight, drawn at the one stroke weight.

The brand mark. One idea, executed cleanly, centred and symmetrical in a square field with even margins on all four sides.

The one idea this mark is built around: a struck coin: one perfect circle drawn as a single uniform-weight outline, and held centred inside that circle one solid ember flame — a teardrop with its point at the top and its base flat. The circle's interior holds that one flame and bare ash ground. Below the circle, separated from it by a clear gap of bare ash ground, the ash ridge is one short flat bar, so the coin reads as standing on ground. Three elements only: the circle, the flame within it, and the bar beneath it.

This mark is wordless and consists purely of shape: every region of the frame is either part of the drawn mark or bare ash ground.

The background is one flat, uniform, unbroken near-black warm ash field, hex #12100f, filling the entire frame from edge to edge. Sample that field at any point — a corner, an edge, the centre, the area directly behind the mark — and it reads exactly #12100f every time: one constant value across the entire field, as though the finished mark had been pasted onto a solid #12100f rectangle. The artwork is the bright thing in the frame and the field behind it is the dark thing: light artwork on dark field, in that order. Draw only the finished mark: the mark and the flat field are the whole of the image, and the mark's own outline is the only edge anywhere in the frame.

Every drawn element is filled or stroked in #e8622c — that exact colour, at full strength. The only permitted exception is the ground line, which may instead be a muted bone #b7ae9b. Every pixel belonging to the artwork carries either #e8622c or the bone, and #e8622c is the dominant colour of the artwork rather than a small detail on it.
assets.licence: cloudsforge-generated: commercial use permitted; AI-generated, C2PA provenance retained
assets.note: Lanczos downscale of the 1024 mark to 256, the size docs/ecosystem/23-tessera.md:321 specifies for the economy icon set. Re-encoding drops the C2PA chunk; the invisible pixel watermark is unaffected and the 1024 source is kept beside this file.
